title: Compare AWS database services (AWS Overview whitepaper)
note: Lesson 3.3 (K08, S04): confirmed AWS's current database-service comparison maps relational to Aurora/RDS/Redshift, key-value to DynamoDB, in-memory to ElastiCache/MemoryDB, document to DocumentDB, wide column to Amazon Keyspaces, graph to Neptune, and time series to Amazon Timestream.
